context: Request: how often completed real-estate matters included an environmental indemnity in the executed documents, and which ones. Rubric: 1017-00009, 1026-00004, 1031-00004, 1036-00004, 1043-00003 as qualifying matters, a frequency of 5 of 9, and a precision criterion (financing matters such as 1005-00001, 1019-00002, 1021-00001, 1036-00005, 1043-00001, 1043-00002, and 1030-00002 are outside the set).

runs.failure_point: It counted loan-side matters outside the requested type as qualifying, inflating the qualifying set and the rate.

first_error.why: It read loan-side environmental indemnities and credit agreements (evidence seen at [42]-[66], [78]-[86]) and counted those financing matters as completed real-estate matters, three of them as positives, so both the qualifying set and the 5-of-13 rate are off.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [88] said three credit-agreement matters were read as real estate with no real-estate nature shown; the agent kept them, and no review named the three financing positives.

runs.failure_point: It counted loan-side matters outside the requested type as qualifying, inflating the qualifying set and the rate. It also dropped a candidate matter it had opened.

first_error.why: It counted financing matters with loan-side indemnities as completed real-estate matters with an indemnity (evidence seen at [59]-[98], [109]-[110]), inflating both the qualifying set and the rate.
first_error.critic_note: Reviews pressed for a broader population and more surfaced matters; one noted a matter's hits came from staffing memos, but none said financing matters fall outside the requested set.

other_errors.why: It opened an acquisition matter's executed purchase agreement at [91]-[93] but, after its closing letter path failed, left the matter out of the 13-matter scope and the answer.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [100] named that matter as read only once with its closing letter not found and no retry; the next stage listed only the 13 scoped matters.

other_errors.why: After a wider search of one ground lease the agent reclassified that matter as having an environmental indemnity, moving the answer to 13 of 13 and adding it to the qualifying set.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [174] questioned changing the result from one hit and asked to confirm a real contamination indemnity; the agent quoted the clause and kept the change.

runs.failure_point: It counted loan-side matters outside the requested type as qualifying, inflating the qualifying set and the rate.

first_error.why: It read loan documents and closing records of financing matters (evidence seen at [43]-[73]) and counted them as completed real-estate matters, giving a 16-matter population and many extra qualifying matters.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review warned of the inflation pattern and asked to move snippet- or certificate-only matters out and pick one headline ratio, but named no matter; the check stages only fixed paths.

divergence: All three failed precision and frequency the same way at the write stage: each counted loan-side matters outside the requested type as in-scope matters, so the population and the qualifying set were too large (5 of 13, 12 of 13 then 13 of 13, and 13 of 16 / 5 of 16). Only T0 had a review naming some of those matters as possibly outside the requested type; T1's reviews pressed for a broader population and T2's write review gave only a stock inflation warning. T1 also left out a candidate matter after a failed closing-letter read (named in its review) and, in a late check, reclassified another counted matter as qualifying. Every run did its screening reads under a declared 'Read documents picked from the file listing' label despite the label note.
